## About
Rijen Automotive Services is a full-service repair shop on Loch Raven Blvd in Towson. We do scheduled maintenance and repairs for your car, truck, van or SUV.
We're also MVA authorized for Maryland tag and title service, so you can renew a registration, transfer a title or order personalized or disability plates in the same place you get your car looked after.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 203 Google reviews. One family wrote that they come to us for everything, from car maintenance to tags and title.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance and repairs: Complete care for your car, truck, van or SUV, from routine maintenance to repairs.
- MVA tag and title service: We're MVA authorized for Maryland tag and title work, including registration renewals and title transfers.
- Personalized and disability plates: Get personalized or disability license plates without a trip to the MVA.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We take care of your car, truck, van or SUV.

Q: Can I do my tag and title work with you instead of the MVA?
A: Yes. We're MVA authorized for Maryland tag and title service, so you can handle it here without waiting all day at the MVA.

Q: What tag and title services do you offer?
A: You can get personalized or disability license plates, renew a registration, transfer a title and more.
